item.title: Trump revives claims of election interference during address to nation
item.description:
The former US president Donald Trump made claims of election interference during a speech to a Republican Party event in Ohio on Saturday night, reviving allegations he raised in the wake of the 2020 presidential election.

Mr. Trump’s speech was a thinly veiled attempt to whip up support for a slate of Republican candidates running in next month’s primary election. The former president used the event to endorse several of the candidates, and also to deliver a broadside against the current administration, which he portrayed as weak and ineffective.

item.title: Lindsey Graham Was Facing Re-election in November. What Happens Now?
item.description:
A Gaping Void: The Aftermath of Lindsey Graham’s Passing

In a shocking turn of events, the passing of Senator Lindsey Graham has left a void in the South Carolina legislative landscape. With his untimely death, the state’s Republican voters will now have to navigate the complexities of a special primary election. The stakes are high, not just for the Republican Party, but also for the nation as a whole. Graham’s departure has opened up a critical seat in the US Senate, and the implications of his passing will be felt for months to come.
